docs.where: Module 01 — Thanksgiving Before the Warfare
docs.text: Beloved, Pastor Kiky did not open this service with a deliverance prayer. She opened it with thanksgiving. There was a reason. Serpentine spirits work in silence, in complaint, in murmuring, in the slow drift of a discouraged heart. Thanksgiving breaks that atmosphere in one instant. It changes the temperature in the room and in the soul.

docs.where: Module 01 — Thanksgiving Before the Warfare
docs.text: Before a single unclean spirit was called out, the pastor gathered the assembly and told them, "Let us thank the Lord." Thanksgiving is not a formality. It is the first weapon in the deliverance flow — praise and worship, then thanksgiving, then confession of sins, then forgiveness, then invitation of the Holy Spirit, then the teaching, then the deliverance, then the sealing. Skip thanksgiving and you enter the warfare from the wrong door.

docs.where: Module 01 — Thanksgiving Before the Warfare
docs.text: We thank Him first for who He is. Then for what He has done in Part One. Then for the very fact that we lived to gather again on Monday for Part Two. Then we thank Him in advance for every deliverance He is about to bring.

docs.text: Beloved, the second movement of the service was confession and forgiveness. Pastor Kiky said it plainly: you cannot invite the Holy Ghost fire into a room that is full of un-repented sin and un-forgiven offense. The fire will come — but you want the fire to burn the enemy, not the flesh that has agreed with him.

docs.text: So we go low. We confess by name whatever the Holy Spirit brings up. We forgive by name whoever the Holy Spirit brings up. We release the wound. We release the debt. We release the memory. And then we invite the fire.

docs.where: Module 02 — Repentance, Forgiveness & Inviting the Holy Ghost Fire
docs.text: The Bible calls this the anointing that breaks the yoke. docs.where: Module 03 — The Enmity in Genesis — Where the Battle Was Declared
docs.text: Beloved, Pastor Kiky went back to the beginning. Before we can cast anything out we have to remember where the enmity began. It began in the garden. It began the moment the serpent opened his mouth to a woman.

docs.where: Module 03 — The Enmity in Genesis — Where the Battle Was Declared
docs.text: Look at his method. He did not enter the garden with force. He entered with a question. "Yea, hath God said…?" He did not tell Eve a lie first — he asked her a question first. The serpent's oldest weapon is not violence, it is subtlety. He gets you to talk with him. He gets you to negotiate. He gets you to explain God's instructions in your own words until the instructions get smaller in your mouth than they were in God's mouth. And once you have shrunk the word of God in your own conversation, the lie comes easily: "Ye shall not surely die."

docs.where: Module 03 — The Enmity in Genesis — Where the Battle Was Declared
docs.text: Then God spoke. Genesis 3:15 is not just a promise, it is a declaration of war. God Himself put the enmity there. You did not manufacture your hatred of the serpent — your Father in heaven planted it in you the day He judged the serpent in the garden. The seed of the woman was to bruise the head of the serpent. That seed is Christ, and every believer is in Christ. That is why you can cast out serpents in His name.

docs.where: Module 03 — The Enmity in Genesis — Where the Battle Was Declared

docs.text: Beloved, Pastor Kiky named the doors. She said we cannot cast out what we refuse to identify. The Holy Spirit will not fight over ground the believer has never taken back. So the pastor walked through the doorways that serpentine spirits use to enter a life.

docs.where: Module 05 — How Serpentine Spirits Enter — Family, Foundation & Familiar Voices
docs.text: Family doors. A grandfather who worshipped a serpent idol. A grandmother who kept a snake in a shrine. A father who consulted a diviner. A mother who wore a piece of serpent jewelry as a covenant sign. Any of these open a legal claim on the descendants unless the descendants rise up and shut the door in the name of Jesus.

docs.where: Module 05 — How Serpentine Spirits Enter — Family, Foundation & Familiar Voices
docs.text: Foundation doors. The village altar. The dedication that was made over you at birth without your knowledge. The naming ceremony that invoked a serpent. The libation that was poured over your infancy. Polygamous witchcraft — the extra wife who used a serpent spirit to divert the affection of a husband and everything he owned. The evil altar that was built in the family compound generations before you were born.

docs.where: Module 05 — How Serpentine Spirits Enter — Family, Foundation & Familiar Voices
docs.text: Personal doors. Dream sex — an intimate encounter in a dream that is not with a lawful spouse. Dream eating — being fed in a dream, especially meat or foods that appear tainted. Occult books, occult jewelry, occult imagery, occult movies watched with fascination. Persistent counsel taken from mediums, "prophets" outside of Christ, herbalists, and diviners.

docs.where: Module 05 — How Serpentine Spirits Enter — Family, Foundation & Familiar Voices

docs.where: Module 06 — The Life Under Attack — Symptoms You Cannot Ignore
docs.text: Riches to rags. A steady descent from provision into lack that cannot be explained by ordinary circumstance. · Grace to grass. A season of clear favor that suddenly collapses into humiliation. · The tail, not the head. A pattern of always being the follower, always being overlooked, always being the last mentioned. · Missed favor. Doors close the moment you arrive. Interviews fall through. Opportunities disappear. · Wrong positioning. You keep ending up in rooms and roles that shrink you rather than lift you. · Chronic error. You do good work and one hidden mistake destroys the whole project. Again. And again. · Refusal of counsel. You suddenly cannot receive sound advice from the people God has placed around you. · Disappearing helpers. Every person the Lord raises up to help you drifts away just before the breakthrough. · Disappearing suitors. Serious relationships that reach the threshold of covenant and then unravel for reasons no one can name. · Spirit-spouse encounters. Dream intimacy, dream weddings, dream children, dream houses. · Juniors overtaking. Peers and juniors leaping ahead of you while your effort produces nothing. · Wasted destiny. Years of prayer, work, giving and sowing with no visible harvest.

docs.where: Module 06 — The Life Under Attack — Symptoms You Cannot Ignore
docs.text: These are not personality flaws. These are not the will of God for a redeemed life. They are the signature of an attack, and Jesus Christ has already crushed the head of the serpent.

docs.where: Module 08 — The Fire, the Viper and the Ancestral Altar
docs.text: Beloved, Pastor Kiky brought the assembly to the crescendo of the service. Communion had been taken. The blood was applied. The confessions had been made. Now — like Paul on the island of Melita — it was time to shake off the viper.

docs.where: Module 08 — The Fire, the Viper and the Ancestral Altar
docs.text: Read what happened. Paul had just survived a shipwreck. The barbarian people showed no little kindness. They kindled a fire. Paul, still in the mercy of God, gathered a bundle of sticks to help. A viper came out of the heat, fastened onto his hand, and hung there. The islanders were sure Paul was under judgment — a murderer whom vengeance had finally caught. Paul did not argue with them. Paul did not describe the viper. He shook the beast off into the fire and felt no harm.

docs.where: Module 08 — The Fire, the Viper and the Ancestral Altar
docs.text: There is your pattern. You do not negotiate with the viper. You do not sit with the viper. You do not describe the viper. You shake it off into the fire. The same Holy Ghost fire that Pentecost fell in is the fire that receives the viper.

docs.where: Module 08 — The Fire, the Viper and the Ancestral Altar
docs.text: Then Pastor Kiky went further. The Holy Spirit does not stop at the viper on the hand — He goes to the altar where the viper was sent from. Every ancestral serpent altar in your father's house, in your mother's house, in your bloodline, in your compound, in your village — the Lord is going to break it now. docs.text: Beloved, Pastor Kiky closed the service the way she opened it — gently. After the fire, the viper and the altar, the pastor called for the anointing oil. docs.where: Module 09 — The Anointing, the Breath of God & the New Beginning
docs.text: First the oil. Anoint yourself. Not as a magic charm — as a sign of consecration. The oil represents the Holy Spirit given to you for protection, for discernment, for favor, for direction. Anoint your forehead, your palms, your feet.

docs.where: Module 09 — The Anointing, the Breath of God & the New Beginning
docs.text: Then the breath. God formed man from the dust of the ground, but man became a living soul when God breathed into his nostrils the breath of life. That breath is the Holy Ghost. In this service the pastor led seven rounds — seven inhales of the Spirit, seven exhales of every unclean deposit. Follow along in your own room. Breathe in deeply through your nose. Hold. Then breathe out, and speak "Out" in the name of Jesus. Every venom, every poison, every python, every cobra, every deposit that your Father did not plant — out.

docs.where: Module 09 — The Anointing, the Breath of God & the New Beginning
docs.text: Then the thanksgiving. You did not deliver yourself. Thank Him for what He has done. Thank Him for what He is still doing. Thank Him for the deliverance He has already sealed in the heavenlies.

docs.where: Module 09 — The Anointing, the Breath of God & the New Beginning
